title: (Approximate) Symmetric Extension Complexity of the Spanning Tree Polytope
summary: We prove a tight lower bound on symmetric LP formulations for the spanning tree polytope of the complete graph. More precisely, let $P_{ST}(K_n)$ be the spanning tree polytope of $K_n$. We show that, for all $n\ge13$, every symmetric extended formulation for $P_{ST}(K_n)$ has at least $\binom n3$ inequalities. Since the classical Martin formulation has a symmetric formulation of size $O(n^3)$, this gives \[ \operatorname{xcs}(P_{ST}(K_n))=Θ(n^3). \] We also study outer relaxations of the spanning tree polytope of $K_n$ for maximization with nonnegative edge weights.
